title: MultiblockCore: Important Systems
summary: Read the MultiblockCore signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Definitions describe shape, progression entries describe unlocks, upgrade definitions alter behavior, and task recipes connect structures to automation goals.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch controller position, orientation, required block variants, empty spaces, validation feedback, upgrade slots, and task recipes connected to the structure.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A MultiblockCore system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
